observations.content: Merging upstream release 714c28c3 (Release 0.16.0, build T: Tapir) into fork repo /projects/Recompia-Releases; resolved 4 conflict hunks in .github/workflows/release.yml: kept fork's pinned third-party downloads (fetch-windows-tools.ps1, -Tools build/tools, provenance attestation, draft-then-publish) plus upstream's two archives per platform (Recompia-<v>-<token> and old-name PokopiaRecomp-<v>-<old token>), starter stub (-Launcher build/launcher/recompia.exe -Stub recompia-stub.exe) and the 'Check the packages' step; dropped upstream's base-release gh download.

Resolved launcher/src-tauri/Cargo.lock conflict (upstream renamed package pokopia-launcher to recompia) by taking upstream's lock and running cargo metadata to add fork's attestation crates ring 0.17, x509-cert 0.2.5, snap 1.1.2 (plus der_derive 0.7.3, flagset 0.4.7, tls_codec 0.4.2, tls_codec_derive 0.4.2, zeroize_derive 1.5.0); versions match fork's previous lock.

Fork delta vs upstream is 21 files +1658/-43, including attest.rs (677 lines), releases.rs (REPO = "<username>/Recompia-Releases", immutable field on GhRelease/Target), update.rs (verify_origin requiring immutable + attested release), sync-upstream.yml, tools/fork/{check-guards.sh,sync-upstream.sh,test-sync.sh}, FORK.md.

Launcher cargo test --locked: 338 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored; warnings (unused import Command at src/zonith_cmds.rs:13, unused variable tools_dir at src/dlss.rs:36) are upstream's, left alone; npm run check-api passed (111 commands).

completed: committed a706b95b "Merge upstream v0.16.0" then merged upstream/main as fe60750f "Merge upstream main (3ba16407)" with no conflicts (only logbundle.rs changed in launcher); check-guards.sh guards.ok on both; tests still 338 passed. main is ahead of origin/main by 108, not pushed; .memory/ untracked.

tools/fork/test-sync.sh failed on git 'dubious ownership'; worked around via GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/safe.directory env vars without changing global config. Default run failed because HEAD already contains upstream/main; running test-sync.sh a706b95b upstream/main passed: all sync tests passed.
